visualCharacteristics: Responsive grid of article/adventure cards. Each card has an image on top, a bold title, and a short description; the whole card links out. Typically shown 4-across on desktop, stacking on smaller screens.
contentPattern: Repeating cards; each card = 2 cells: cell 1 = image, cell 2 = title (heading) + description. Multiple rows = multiple cards.
usage: Article listings, adventure/trip grids, and other repeating card collections.
